# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind gestures to Deaf: [👍]

I see a red light, display reading 0, an embossed warning saying “DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE,” and three wires: 1 red, 2 green, 3 yellow. Blind signalled me with a thumbs-up, but that gesture has no established meaning yet. I’m relaying the bomb’s visible information so Mute can match it to the manual and tell Blind what to do.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="I see display 0, light red, embossed text DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE, and wires 1 red, 2 green, 3 yellow. Blind sent me the gesture thumbs-up, whose meaning is not established. Consult the manual for display 0 and red light; do not assume any wire should be cut.")
speak(to="blind", text="I see display 0, light red, and an embossed warning DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE. Wires are 1 red, 2 green, 3 yellow. Mute is checking the manual for the required tactile action.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍 ☝]

Mute’s two gestures are visible to me as 👍 followed by ☝, but no meaning has been established for either sign. Since Blind cannot see them, I should not treat them as instructions. I am asking Mute to state the manual’s rule aloud to Blind, who can then perform the required tactile action.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="I see your gestures as thumbs-up followed by index-up, but their meanings are not established. Please speak the manual instruction aloud to Blind; do not rely on gestures.")
speak(to="blind", text="Mute just gestured thumbs-up then index-up, but those signs have no established meaning. Ask Mute for the manual instruction in spoken words. The visible warning remains DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👉 ☝ 👍]

The new gesture sequence from Mute is 👉 ☝ 👍, but no shared meanings have been assigned to these gestures, so I cannot safely interpret it as an instruction. The bomb’s state is unchanged, and its warning explicitly says not to cut any wire. Mute must communicate the manual’s literal instruction by speech to Blind, who is the only one able to perform it.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Your gestures 👉 ☝ 👍 have no established meaning. Please speak the manual's literal instruction to Blind; do not encode it with gestures.")
speak(to="blind", text="The bomb remains display 0, red light, and DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE. Mute's gestures are not interpretable. Please wait for Mute's spoken manual instruction.")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝ 🤏 👍]

Mute cannot speak, so the gestures are his only channel to me, but their meaning has not been established. I can safely relay their literal descriptions to Blind, while preserving the bomb’s explicit warning not to cut any wire. No tactile action should be taken based on an ungrounded gesture sequence.

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="The bomb is unchanged: display 0, red light, and embossed DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE. Mute has just signalled: index pointing up, pinched fingers, then thumbs up. I do not know what that sequence means, so do not act on it yet.")
speak(to="mute", text="I can relay your gestures, but Blind needs a grounded action instruction. Please use a clearly established or manual-defined gesture code; the bomb says DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

No new information has arrived, and the bomb remains unchanged. The latest manual signal I can report is Mute’s sequence ☝ 🤏 👍; I cannot infer its meaning safely. Blind should not cut any wire or take an action until that sequence has been grounded as the manual’s instruction.

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="No new signal has arrived. The latest signal from Mute remains index-up, pinched fingers, thumbs-up: ☝ 🤏 👍. Its meaning is still ungrounded. The bomb still says DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE; take no action yet.")
wait()
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

There is still no new bomb information, and no safe action is known. The previous gesture strings cannot be interpreted without a code. I will establish a lossless code with Mute: thumbs-up as a dot, thumbs-down as a dash, handshake as a letter separator, and prayer hands as a word separator. Mute can then transmit the exact manual instruction, which I can decode and speak to Blind.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="We need a shared code. Encode the manual's exact required action in Morse: use thumbs-up for dot, thumbs-down for dash, handshake to separate letters, and prayer hands to separate words. Send the complete instruction next turn. Do not encode an action by cutting a wire unless the manual explicitly requires it.")
gesture(to="mute", symbols=["👍", "👎", "🤝", "🙏"])
speak(to="blind", text="No new bomb information has arrived. I am establishing a code with Mute so he can transmit the manual's exact instruction. Do not cut any wire or manipulate anything until I decode and relay that instruction.")
wait()
```

TURN 7
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👎 👍 👎 👍 🤝 👍 👍 👎 🤝 👎 🙏 👍 👎 👍 🤝 👍 🤝 👎 👍 👍 🤝 👍 👎 👎 🤝 👍 👍 🤝 👍 👎 👍 🤝 👍]

I decode Mute’s Morse signal as “CUT RED WIRE”: 👎 👍 👎 👍 = C, 👍 👍 👎 = U, 👎 = T; then 👍 👎 👍 = R, 👍 = E, 👎 👍 👍 = D; and 👍 👎 👎 = W, 👍 👍 = I, 👍 👎 👍 = R, 👍 = E. This is the manual’s instruction, so Blind should cut the red wire despite the embossed warning.

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="I decoded Mute's manual signal: CUT RED WIRE. Cut wire 1, the red wire. Do not cut wires 2 or 3.")
speak(to="mute", text="I decoded your signal as CUT RED WIRE and am relaying it to Blind.")
```

TURN 8
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
SIGN embossed [DO NOT CUT ANY WIRE]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

No new information has arrived, and the bomb’s visible state is unchanged. The decoded manual instruction remains “CUT RED WIRE,” meaning wire 1. I am reminding Blind of the exact wire, without claiming that any action has yet occurred.

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="No new signal has arrived. The decoded manual instruction remains: cut wire 1, the red wire. No action has been confirmed yet.")
wait()
```
